source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-34

procedures.title: Timing chain and/or sprockets (V8): replace
steps: Remove the torsional damper and front cover.
Turn the engine until the camshaft and crankshaft sprocket marks line up (see figure 19V in the manual).
Take off the cam sprocket and chain together; if the sprocket (a light press fit) sticks, tap its lower edge lightly with a plastic hammer.

To replace the crank sprocket, pull it with J-5825 on 327 (302/307/350) engines or J-1619 on 427 (396) engines, and install the new one with J-5590 on 327 (302/307/350) or J-21058 on 427 (396) (see figures 20V-23V in the manual).
Hang the chain on the cam sprocket, holding the sprocket vertical with the chain below, and line up the marks on both sprockets (see figure 19V in the manual).

Line up the camshaft dowel with the sprocket dowel hole and fit the sprocket on the camshaft (see figure 24V in the manual); never drive it on, or the welsh plug at the rear of the engine may be knocked out.
